request.raw_text: Multiply amount of cylindrical feature to 4. Imagine this is a system of plant pots, so you need to add stability to that afterwards by adding another legs or ribs on the sides.

areas_to_change.action: Increase the cylindrical feature count to four total
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Existing upright hollow cylindrical feature and its rounded mounting transition
areas_to_change.location: On the upper face of the long rectangular base, extending from the existing feature toward the straight end
areas_to_change.description: Retain the existing cylindrical pot-holder form and create three additional matching instances, preferably arranged as a longitudinal pattern with practical spacing along the base.

areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Long side faces of the narrow base and the regions supporting the cylindrical features
areas_to_change.location: On both lateral sides of the base, distributed symmetrically where needed to resist tipping
areas_to_change.description: Add side-extending legs, gussets, or ribs after increasing the pot-holder count. The supports should be joined to the base and widen or reinforce its effective footprint without obstructing the cylindrical openings.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its outside diameter, bore diameter, height, vertical orientation, open top, and rounded lower transition; use it as the template for the additional instances.
Preserve the existing base thickness, primary longitudinal form, straight long edges, flat faces, and straight terminal end except where local unions with new supports are required.
Preserve the existing rounded end profile and its relationship to the original cylindrical feature.
Keep all four openings unobstructed and coaxial with their respective vertical cylindrical bodies.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: An elongated base carrying four matching upright hollow cylindrical pot holders, with additional symmetric side legs or reinforcing ribs attached to the narrow base.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The model becomes a multi-pot holder capable of supporting four plant pots while providing greater resistance to lateral tipping and base flexure.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: Loads from the four pots are transferred into the elongated base and then into a wider or more strongly reinforced support footprint, improving static stability compared with the original single-cylinder design.

ambiguities.description: The request does not specify whether the value 4 means four cylindrical features in total or four additional features.
candidate_interpretations: Create four cylindrical features total, retaining the existing one and adding three.
Add four new cylindrical features, producing five total.

ambiguities.description: The placement and spacing of the four cylindrical features are unspecified.
candidate_interpretations: Arrange all four in one evenly spaced longitudinal row along the base.
Keep the original location and place the other three according to available base length.
Use another symmetric or staggered arrangement if the base width is increased.

ambiguities.description: The requested stabilizing geometry is described alternatively as legs or ribs, without dimensions or count.
candidate_interpretations: Add paired transverse feet extending from both long sides.
Add triangular gusset ribs between each cylindrical holder and the base.
Add continuous longitudinal side flanges or ribs.
Combine lateral feet with local gusset ribs near each cylindrical feature.

ambiguities.description: The amount of base widening or reinforcement required for stability is not quantified.
candidate_interpretations: Use minimal local supports while retaining the current base envelope.
Extend supports laterally to create a substantially wider footprint.
Size the supports based on assumed pot diameter, mass, and center-of-gravity requirements.
